verdict.rationale: Aleph documents team and user permissions that control who can access sensitive data (aleph-docs-18) and fine-grained permissions with access controls and audit logs (aleph-docs-25). It also markets budget planning that budget owners update themselves (aleph-docs-26). However, nothing shows that permissions can be scoped to a department's slice of the numbers, or that edit rights can be separated from company-wide visibility. missing for 10: explicit department- or dimension-level data scoping, documented view-vs-edit rights for budget owners, independent or hands-on corroboration.
